issues.title: Conflicting cached eSaabParts stock displays prevent treating quantities as verified live inventory
issues.cause: Retailer individual part pages, diagram views and web-indexed snapshots can differ in quantity, shipping location or age of content.
symptoms: The same T7 cassette appears with '2' and '20+' units across cached sources
Nissens radiator retailer search snippet says Sweden available but product page says four available
A lower-priced HEPU replacement is marked unavailable
issues.diagnosis_summary: Confirm exact current listed SKU, estimated delivery to buyer ZIP, VIN application, hardware in package, warranty and core charge with seller before relying on stock or budget.
issues.correction_summary: Store observation date and exact source page; no permanent inventory assertion, no replacement readiness or quantitative vehicle model reliability score.
limits: Cached pages and dynamic inventory are not direct order fulfillment or contract quote
No order placed, account access or inventory guaranteed
Different catalogue source views may reflect separate warehouses or update intervals
